title: Re: All Up In Abaddon's Family Business
description: Re: All Up In Abaddon's Family Business — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Ol' Chuck Pail

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kill Abazabaddon, Abadabadooddon, Abracadabraddonna, Abadunkadunkaddonna, Abadumdadumdummmddon, Abadupercalifragilisticexpialidociousddonna, and Abaddon and Return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Quest Reward: Gold and 4 King's Coins

Return to: Ol' Chuck Pail

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: The Embercore Path

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill Abazabaddon, Abadabadooddon, Abracadabraddonna, Abadunkadunkaddonna, Abadumdadumdummmddon, Abadupercalifragilisticexpialidociousddonna, and Abaddon and Return to Ol' Chuck Pail in The Embercore Portal.

Offer:

Wait, you do want to try this quest again? Are you what they call a powder gamer? Or is it a harpsichord gamer? I don't know, I'm out of the loop.

Seek out Abazabaddon, Abadabadooddon, Abracadabraddonna, Abadunkadunkaddonna, Abadumdadumdummmddon, Abadupercalifragilisticexpialidociousddonna, and Abaddon and slay them where they stand...or sit...or kneel...or dabble...or shamble...or monkey around...or whatever! You get the idea. Return to me, Ol' Chuck Pail, here in The Embercore Portal when you hath slain them all! That should give me some time to fill the appropriate paperwork to get your reward.

Turn-in:

You've done it again? Well, good news indeed. Here is your reward, fresh from the coffers of the King's Board of Trustees. Let me know if you want to do this quest again you masochistic freak!

Objectives:

  • Kill Abazabaddon
  • Kill Abadabadooddon
  • Kill Abracadabraddonna
  • Kill Abadunkadunkaddonna
  • Kill Abadumdadumdummmddon
  • Kill Abadupercalifragilisticexpialidociousddonna
  • Kill Abaddon

Level range: 47–100
